itemized.notes: MEMBER 3 OF THE SKYLER BELTRAN THREE-DOCUMENT CLUSTER (00c19030 / ccccb017 / 0cb7a1c6). ⚠⚠ CLUSTER VERDICT FOR THIS DOCUMENT (§K2): it is kind (3), THE SAME REPORT RE-PUBLISHED WITH A REDACTION PASS — the county's redacted issue of the very report 00c19030 publishes in the clear. Not an original, not a revision, not a different report. Row-level evidence, not total-level: same report type ticked ('Seven days preceding the General Election'), same amendment answer ('No'), same typed cover, same dotloop banners (dtlp.us/hJgj-FYBE-0IZc on pp1/3 and dtlp.us/vICx-xBiz-HQPm on pp2/4), same Date of Report 10/28/2024, same clerk RECEIVED stamp OCT 30 2024, same seven-page shape with the same three mastheads, and EVERY ledger line identical — all 23 contribution rows and all 39 expenditure rows, the same five page subtotals (5350 / 8,544.23 / 2,458.67 / 810.64 / 580.64), the same struck typed grand totals with the same 'SMB' corrections, and the same six summary boxes. The grids even measure identically to the hundredth of a percent, so the redaction was applied to the SAME digital file rather than to a re-scan. THE ONLY DIFFERENCES ARE THE COUNTY'S BLACK BARS, and they are consequential for the donor layer: on the cover the candidate's street address, phone number and signature are barred (all in the clear on 00c19030), and on p2 the county blacked out each donor's street — but NOT UNIFORMLY. On rows 1, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 14 and 15 the bar stops short and the city, state and zip survive; on rows 2, 3, 5, 9, 12 and 13 THE BAR COVERS THE CITY TOO, leaving only the state and zip. Those six rows therefore carry an honestly BLANK donor_city on this record — the city was NOT carried across from the unredacted sibling, because a value may come only from the row's own cell on its own document (§C3 / §L6, and the same discipline as the riverton mislabeled-source precedent). This is the practical demonstration of §K2's point that a redaction pass WITHHOLDS disclosure the other copy makes, and of §I1's 'judge redaction from the page, per cell': p3, p4, p5 and p6 carry no bar at all, so the same filing is redacted on one Schedule A sheet and untouched on the other. Independent agreement with 00c19030 on all 62 amounts, all five page subtotals and both grand totals is CORROBORATION and is recorded on every row; the geometry was re-measured and re-proved on this PDF (§K1).
